metadata.directionPolicy: For manifestation -> concept, broadMatch means the target concept is broader; narrowMatch means the target concept is narrower.
metadata.reviewPolicy: Discovery mappings do not authorize aggregation. Disease, eligibility, diagnostic or control criterion, denominator, cohort, reporting period, portal version and facility level must be verified.

concepts.label: NCD digital reporting adoption
concepts.definition: Use of the programme information system by expected facilities and users within a stated period.
mappingRows: Manifestation uses expected programme health facilities as denominator.

concepts.label: NCD population enrolment and identity linkage
concepts.definition: Registration of eligible people in the NCD information system and creation of their source-defined digital health identity.
mappingRows: Manifestation covers eligible people aged 30 years and above.
Manifestation uses enrolled people, rather than all eligible people, as denominator.

concepts.label: NCD screening and diagnosis coverage
concepts.definition: Reach of source-defined NCD screening or diagnosis among an explicitly eligible population.
mappingRows: Manifestation covers eligible people aged 30 years and above and source-defined common NCDs.

concepts.label: NCD diagnostic follow-up completion
concepts.definition: Completion of diagnostic work-up among people who screened positive for an NCD.
mappingRows: The training module explicitly defines both numerator and denominator.
Existing manifestation aligns conceptually but retains programme-defined metadata.
Existing manifestation may include follow-up beyond diagnostic work-up.

concepts.label: NCD treatment initiation and current treatment
concepts.definition: Entry into or current receipt of source-defined NCD treatment or standard care among diagnosed people.
mappingRows: Manifestation includes lifestyle modification and treatment for diagnosed people aged 30 years and above.
Manifestation is restricted to a specified set of NCD conditions.

concepts.label: NCD cohort reporting completeness
concepts.definition: Inclusion of registered NCD patients in source-defined cohort and control reporting.
mappingRows: Manifestation jointly covers hypertension and diabetes and requires the registered cohort denominator.

concepts.label: NCD clinical control among people in care
concepts.definition: Achievement of disease-specific clinical control criteria among a defined treatment or cumulative-care cohort.
mappingRows: Manifestation is hypertension-specific and uses a previous-three-month control window.
Official wording says blood-pressure control for people with diabetes; semantic equivalence is not asserted.
Manifestation combines source-defined control values across unspecified NCDs.
Existing registry manifestation does not specify disease, clinical criterion or cohort.

concepts.label: Change in hypertension and diabetes incidence
concepts.definition: Source-defined change in new hypertension and diabetes occurrence in a population over time.
mappingRows: The source does not supply a computable operational formula and requires study-method metadata.

concepts.label: Essential NCD medicine availability
concepts.definition: Availability of source-defined essential NCD medicines without a stock-out during a specified period.
mappingRows: Existing manifestation requires medicine list, facility denominator and stock-out period from the operational dictionary.

concepts.label: NCD screening session delivery
concepts.definition: Delivery of planned population-based NCD screening sessions in the source-defined place and period.
mappingRows: Existing manifestation needs the exact session plan and cancellation rules.
